train_rotamer_model: train a protein rotamer energy-based model using a transformer, FC, Set2Set, or graph neural network architecture
test_rotamer_model: test a trained protein rotamer EBM model by evaluating reconstruction accuracy and rotamer recovery scores
add_args_parser: add command-line arguments for training hyperparameters, dataset config, distributed training, transformer settings, and EBM parameters
compute_lr_schedule: compute the learning rate at a given iteration using warmup and optional inverse_sqrt annealing schedule
average_gradients_distributed: average gradients across distributed workers and sync model parameters for multi-GPU training
